# Jean Massad

> Jean Massad is a design lead at Surge AI and runs Konpo, a design studio. Brand, websites, product and design systems for startups, F500, government and everything in between, from napkin sketch through final_final release.

- Name: Jean Massad
- Role: Design Lead at Surge AI (https://www.surgehq.ai)
- Studio: runs Konpo, a design studio (https://www.konpo.studio)
- Website: https://jean.md
- Focus: brand identity, websites, product design, design systems

The site at https://jean.md is a single interactive page (a feed of work stills and clips). The same content is available as plain Markdown at https://jean.md/index.md, and each project links to its full case study on konpo.studio.

## Work

- [Surge AI](https://www.konpo.studio/?news=surge-ai): Brand and website for the data engine behind frontier AI. Brand, Website.
- [Fyler](https://www.konpo.studio/work/fyler-search-engine): Brand, marketing site, and product UI for AI-native search. Website, Product, Brand.
- [ComPsych](https://www.konpo.studio/work/compsych): Rebranding the world's largest employee mental-health provider. Brand, Website.
- [Coachable](https://www.konpo.studio/work/coachable): Identity and website for career-changing coaching. Brand, Website.
- [System One](https://www.konpo.studio/work/system-one): Brand and website for film-led storytelling. Brand, Website.
- [ILI.DIGITAL](https://www.konpo.studio/work/ili-digital): The Nexus brand system, from logo to product. Brand, Website.
- [Hutte](https://www.konpo.studio/work/hutte): Identity and product for the home of Salesforce DevOps. Brand, Product.
